kebab_example: aliyun winnexo send-async-chat-message --tenant-id 10000 --content '示例内容' --content-type Text --session-id exampleSessionId --digital-employee-name pcitc-magent --model quick --files type=text fileId=exampleFileId --stream true --reuse-last-session false --direct-chat false --enable-web-search false --task-execution '{"operatingObjectName":"string_value","executionId":"exampleExecutionId","skillCodes":["code"],"taskUnderstand":"string_value","billingId":"exampleBillingId","tenantId":"10000","enableWebSearch":true,"taskName":"string_value","userId":"exampleUserId","taskId":"exampleTaskId"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendAsyncChatMessage

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数，缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The body of the user message
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The message type. Valid values: Text and Markdown
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.help_en: The session ID. If not specified, a new session is created
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The list of digital employee names. For compatibility with the legacy format, a single string can also be passed
parameters.help_zh: 数字员工名称列表（兼容旧格式可传单个字符串）
parameters.name: digital_employee_name

parameters.help_en: The abstract model tier. Valid values: quick, standard, and flagship. If not specified, standard is used for new sessions, and the current tier is retained for existing sessions
parameters.help_zh: 抽象模型档位（quick / standard / flagship）；缺省时新会话用 standard，已有会话沿用会话当前档位
parameters.name: model

fields.help_en: The file ID, which is returned by the uploadChatFile operation
fields.help_zh: 文件 ID，由 uploadChatFile 返回
fields.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The list of file references. Each item is an object, and the fileId parameter is required. The fileId is returned by the uploadChatFile operation
parameters.help_zh: 文件引用列表；每项为对象，fileId 必传（由 uploadChatFile 返回）
parameters.name: files

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use streaming generation. This operation always generates backend content in streaming mode and writes it to the message stream. The value of this parameter does not change the response structure
parameters.help_zh: 是否流式生成；本接口固定按流式生成后台内容并写入消息流，取值不改变返回结构
parameters.name: stream

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to reuse the most recent session under the digital employee when sessionId is not specified. This is typically used in CLI scenarios. Default value: false, which means a new session is created
parameters.help_zh: 不传 sessionId 时是否复用该数字员工下最近一个会话（CLI 场景），缺省 false 即新建会话
parameters.name: reuse_last_session

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable direct connection mode. If set to true, regular scenario routing is skipped and the direct conversation scenario is used
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用直连模式；true 时跳过常规场景路由，直接进入直连对话场景
parameters.name: direct_chat

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable web search. Default value: false. In the task execution scenario where taskExecution is passed, the task configuration prevails
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用联网搜索，默认 False；任务执行场景（传 taskExecution）下以任务配置为准
parameters.name: enable_web_search

parameters.help_en: The session work mode. Valid values: ask (quick Q&A, which trims tools, skills, and connectors for single-turn direct answers), work (deep work, default), and direct (direct connection mode at the request level, which does not start a sandbox and prevents context pollution, equivalent to directChat=true). The ask and work modes are session-level. The mode is fixed when a new session is created and inherited by default in subsequent chats. If the explicitly passed value is inconsistent with the session mode, a parameter error is returned. To switch modes, create a new session or fork the current one. If ask is passed in multi-digital-employee or task execution scenarios, it takes effect as work. This parameter is ignored when directChat is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 会话工作模式：ask=快速问答（裁剪工具/技能/连接器，单轮直答）；work=深度工作（默认）；direct=直连模式（请求级：不启动沙箱、无上下文污染，等同 directChat=true）。ask/work 为会话级：新建会话时选定后即固化，续聊时默认继承会话模式；显式传值与会话模式不一致时返回参数错误（如需切换，请新建会话或 Fork）。多数字员工或任务执行场景传 ask 时按 work 生效；directChat=true 时本参数被忽略
parameters.name: work_mode

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable web search
fields.name: enable_web_search

fields.help_en: The name of the digital employee
fields.name: operating_object_name

fields.help_en: The list of associated skill codes
fields.name: skill_codes

fields.help_en: The ID of the tenant to which the task belongs
fields.name: tenant_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the user to which the task belongs
fields.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The task execution metadata returned by the executeScheduledTask operation. If passed, the request is processed through the task execution pipeline
parameters.help_zh: executeScheduledTask 返回的任务执行元数据；传入后按任务执行链路处理
parameters.name: task_execution

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success. A failure returns a backend error code, such as ERR.* or InvalidParameter.*
code.description_zh: 业务状态码：成功为 200，失败为后端错误码（ERR.* / InvalidParameter.*）

message.description_en: The error description. This parameter is empty when the request is successful

messageId.description_en: The assistant message ID, which is used to subscribe to the generation results by subsequently calling the streamChatMessage operation
messageId.description_zh: 助手消息ID；用于随后调用 streamChatMessage 订阅生成结果

sessionCreated.description_en: Indicates whether a new session was created in this call
sessionCreated.description_zh: 本次调用是否新建了会话

sessionId.description_en: The session ID. This value is the same as the input parameter when continuing a session, and is generated by the server when a new session is created
sessionId.description_zh: 会话ID；续写会话时与入参一致，新建会话时为服务端生成值

workMode.description_en: The session work mode that actually takes effect in the current turn. Valid values: ask (quick Q&A), work (deep work), and direct (direct connection mode at the request level). If ask is passed in multi-digital-employee or task execution scenarios, it takes effect as work
workMode.description_zh: 本轮实际生效的会话工作模式：ask=快速问答；work=深度工作；direct=直连模式（请求级）。多数字员工或任务执行场景传 ask 时按 work 生效
